g.text: Measured configurations meeting 95% recall in every repeat
Bars select the highest median QPS among measured configurations meeting the common recall/result-validity floor; other panels use that same configuration.
Bars are repeat medians; whiskers are repeat min–max, not confidence intervals. Per-label regressions remain in the provenance JSON.
